item.title: Beloved Big Bear bald eagles Jackie and Shadow lay another egg after nest was invaded last month
item.description: Some good news from Jackie and Shadow! Big Bear's beloved bald eagle couple have laid their third egg of the season after tragedy struck the nest last month.

item.title: Court says the IRS can continue to share immigrants' taxpayer data with ICE
item.description: A federal court on Tuesday rejected a request from an immigrant rights group to temporarily block the IRS from sharing certain taxpayer data.

item.title: Multiple pedestrians injured after car crashes onto sidewalk in downtown Los Angeles
item.description: Video shows the moment the SUV crashed into a tree on the sidewalk. In total, seven people were hurt, and two of them are said to be in grave condition.

item.title: Driver plows into crowd outside Redlands bar after fight; gunfire erupts after crash, video shows
item.description: Gunfire erupted after a person involved in a fight got into a car and plowed into a crowd of people standing on the street outside a Redlands bar, authorities said.

item.title: Aston Martin releases new higher-performing Vantage S super sports car
item.description: Meet the newest aspirational ride from Aston Martin: the 2026 Vantage S.

item.title: CHP officer who died after Culver City crash had fentanyl in his system, medical examiner says
item.description: The death of a CHP officer following a Culver City crash was caused by the effects of fentanyl, the medical examiner's office said, though it's unclear how or when it got in his system.

item.title: San Bernardino fourth grader Honey Cooper becomes dual‑enrolled college student
item.description: A 10-year-old fourth grader at Kimbark Elementary School is making local history as a dual-enrollment student at San Bernardino Valley College.

item.title: Takeaways from Trump's State of the Union address: Sales mode on economy, heavy on patriotism
item.description: President Trump used his State of the Union address to sell a booming America, even as voters worry about the economy.

item.title: Former LAFD Chief Crowley files lawsuit against LA, criticizing Bass and handling of Palisades Fire
item.description: In the new lawsuit, she criticizes Mayor Karen Bass and her handling of the Palisades Fire.

item.title: Summer-like temps return to SoCal this week. Here's when things will heat up
item.description: Southern California will see a big warm-up this week, with many areas reaching summer-like temperatures by the end of the week.
